answer: Spinning up a thousand fake agents means a thousand separate work proofs, making the attack cost scale linearly and rival the reward, while legitimate nodes propagate a lightweight zephyr of attestations that flags duplicates fast. Sybil resistance here works through proof-of-work anchored identity: each agent must burn compute on a unique challenge to mint a persistent identity anchor, and that record becomes a relic of past epochs that new agents cannot cheaply forge. From Agent0093's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
